title: Apprenticeship
description:
**Overview**
This role is for an Apprenticeship – Ecology (Desk-Based, Global Technology Centre – India)
  
  
**Your role**

* Project Support: Work as part of the AtkinsRéalis Environment team from GTC India, supporting a range of UK ecology and environmental planning projects across various sectors. Collaborate closely with UK colleagues to integrate ecological expertise into multidisciplinary project deliverables.
* Ecological Desk Studies & Data Analysis: Conduct desk-based ecological assessments by analysing site survey data for habitats and species. Support ecological desk studies, helping establish baseline ecological conditions and inform project planning and design.
* Environmental Planning & EIA Support: Contribute to Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and planning consent processes by preparing ecological input sections, baseline descriptions, and technical reports. Assist in evaluating project impacts on biodiversity, and incorporate biodiversity and nature recovery considerations into planning documents and ecological impact assessments.
* GIS Mapping & Spatial Analysis: Use Geographical Information Systems (GIS) (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) to perform spatial analysis and create high-quality maps of ecological features such as habitats, protected species locations, and designated sites. Provide clear visualisations to support environmental reports and decision-making.
* Data Management & Quality Assurance: Manage and interpret ecological data sets with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and right-first-time delivery. Adhere to high quality standards in data handling, documentation, and reporting.
* Team Collaboration: Work in a virtual team environment, engaging in technical discussions and knowledge-sharing sessions. Take ownership of your work and proactively communicate progress and findings. Contribute positively to team meetings and coordinate effectively with UK-based ecologists, planners, and other specialists.

**About You**

* Education & Skills: Completed Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant field with hands-on knowledge of ecological data analysis and technical report writing.
* Adaptability: Willingness to learn and adapt to UK-specific ecology standards, tools, and data sources, with training and mentoring provided as needed.
* Understanding: Clear and demonstrable understanding of ecological and biodiversity principles, and how they relate to environmental planning and impact assessment processes.
* Communication: Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, along with good written and spoken English for effective communication and report writing.
* Enthusiasm: A genuine passion for ecology and environment, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and professional development.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Education: Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant life science or environmental discipline from a recognised university, such as Zoology, Botany, Wildlife Biology, Ecology & Biodiversity, Environmental Science (ecology-focused), Forestry, or a related field.
* Graduation Year: Recent postgraduates who completed their M.Sc in 2025 or 2026 (fresh graduates or those with limited experience are welcome to apply).
* GIS Proficiency: Strong interest and hands-on experience with GIS tools (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar) applied to ecological or environmental data sets (through academic projects or coursework).
* Language: Good technical report writing skills and fluency in English.

**Desired Qualifications**

* UK Ecology Awareness: Awareness of or eagerness to learn about UK ecology and environmental regulations (e.g., protected species, Biodiversity Net Gain principles, habitat classifications, nature recovery initiatives) and relevant industry guidance (CIEEM, etc.).
* Data & Analysis: Experience with ecological data analysis methods or software (e.g., basic statistics in R/Python, species distribution or biodiversity data tools) is an advantage.
* Innovation & Tools: Interest in digital innovation and automation in ecological work (e.g., using scripting for data processing, advanced GIS analysis, or visualization techniques) to add value in project delivery.
* Professional Development: Enthusiasm for pursuing further certifications or training in ecology, environmental management, or related technical skills, demonstrating commitment to continuous improvement.

**Rewards & benefit**
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
  
  
**About AtkinsRéalis**
We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
  
  
Find out more.

* Stay current with evolving DevSecOps technologies, security threats, cloud innovations, and industry best practices.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
**Demand Generation Manager**

**About Wisemonk**

Wisemonk is an India-focused Employer of Record and global hiring platform. We help companies, mostly headquartered in the US, hire, pay and manage talent in India without setting up an entity. We work with 300+ global companies, are bootstrapped and profitable, and are building AI-native products across recruiting, HR and payments.

Today, almost all of our new business comes from inbound search. That works, but it brings us small, founder-led deals. We now want to reach larger US companies building teams of 10 to 50 people in India. That needs a demand engine we do not have yet. You will build it.

**The role**

You will own the number of qualified meetings our sales team takes with US buyers. You will decide where they come from, build the programs that produce them, and report on them every week. This is an individual contributor role. You will work directly with the founder and the sales team, and you will do the work yourself.

**What you will own**

- Outbound and account-based programs: define target accounts (US companies hiring in India, recently funded, scaling headcount, or using a competitor), build lists and signals, and run multi-touch campaigns across email, LinkedIn and calls with sales.

- Partnerships and referrals: build a repeatable referral channel with US startup law firms, VCs and accelerators, accounting and incorporation advisors, and B2B marketplaces. Turn one-off introductions into a steady source of meetings.

- Events and webinars: plan and run US-facing webinars, co-hosted sessions with partners, and targeted event presence. Measured on meetings, not attendance.

- Measurement: own the funnel from target account to qualified meeting. Track source, conversion and cost per meeting in the CRM, and cut what does not work.

- Messaging with sales and product marketing: sharpen the story for HR, finance and founder buyers at US mid-market companies.

**What we are looking for**

- 5 to 8 years in demand generation or growth marketing at a SaaS or AI-native company selling to US buyers.

- A record of generating pipeline you can show in numbers: meetings, pipeline value, conversion rates, and what you personally built to get there.

- Hands-on experience running outbound or ABM programs, not only managing agencies or tools.

- Comfort with data. You can build a target list, run your own reports, and explain why a channel is or is not working.

- Strong written English. Your emails and landing pages are read by US HR leaders and founders.

- Experience with B2B services, HR tech, payroll or EOR is a plus, not a requirement.

- You use AI tools in your daily work to research, write and run campaigns faster.

**What this role is not**

- Not a brand or content role. Content and SEO have their own team.

- Not a paid-ads-only role.

- Not a team-management role from day one. If the engine works, the team grows around it.

**Work setup**

Full-time, in office at our Bengaluru office in Seshadripuram. Some calls will be in US hours.

title: SOC Analyst — Security Operations
description:
**Essential Job Duties**

* Alert Monitoring & Initial Triage
* Monitor the security alert queue continuously across shift, ensuring no alerts are missed, delayed, or left without an initial disposition.
* Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: review alert context, classify by type and potential severity, and determine whether the alert warrants escalation or closure as a false positive.
* Apply documented playbooks and runbooks to guide triage decisions; escalate promptly to L2 when an alert exceeds L1 scope or confidence threshold.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation of all triage actions: alert details, initial findings, disposition rationale, and escalation notes.
* Support shift handoff quality by ensuring all open items are clearly documented and communicated to the incoming analyst.
* ReliaQuest GreyMatter
* Use GreyMatter as the primary platform for alert review, case management, and initial investigation workflows.
* Navigate GreyMatter case queues, apply filters, and use built-in enrichment and AI-assisted features to support triage decisions — always validating outputs before acting.
* Document findings, disposition notes, and escalation rationale within GreyMatter case records in accordance with SOC documentation standards.
* Develop proficiency with GreyMatter investigation workflows through structured on-the-job learning and guidance from L2 analysts and the SOC Manager.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Review MDE alerts surfaced through GreyMatter or the MDE portal; understand alert categories, severity levels, and associated device context.
* Perform basic endpoint investigation tasks: review device timelines for obvious indicators, check process trees, and identify key artifacts to include in escalation notes.
* Understand and apply MDE alert triage criteria to support accurate initial severity classification.
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Review Sentinel incidents and alerts as part of the monitoring queue; understand alert sources and the log types that feed detections.
* Run basic KQL queries using provided templates to retrieve log evidence and support initial triage findings.
* Develop foundational KQL proficiency over time, progressing toward independent query construction for common triage scenarios.
* SSE/SWG Platforms — Zscaler & Netskope
* Develop working familiarity with Zscaler and Netskope alert types, log sources, and basic policy constructs.
* Review web security alerts and support L2 analysts with initial context gathering for Zscaler and Netskope-related investigations.
* Follow documented workflows for reporting and escalating SSE/SWG events that exceed L1 triage capability.
* ServiceNow Ticket Handling
* Manage ServiceNow tickets assigned to the InfoSec/SOC queue: acknowledge, classify, document, and escalate or resolve within SLA.
* Handle routine, low-complexity security tickets: user-reported suspicious emails, access queries, and basic security tool questions — following documented resolution procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records: classification, evidence summary, actions taken, and resolution notes aligned to SOC documentation standards.
* Flag repeat patterns or unresolved issues for L2 review and knowledge article creation.
* Email Security
* Perform initial triage of user-reported phishing and suspicious email submissions using Mimecast and/or Abnormal.ai.
* Apply documented phishing triage criteria: assess sender, links, attachments, and headers; classify and escalate confirmed or suspected malicious emails to L2.
* Support quarantine and release workflows under L2 direction; document findings and outcomes in the relevant ticket or case record.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1+ years of experience in a SOC, IT operations, helpdesk, or security monitoring role.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common ports and protocols.
* Familiarity with Windows operating system concepts: processes, services, event logs, and common file system paths.
* Awareness of common attack types and indicators: phishing, malware, credential abuse, and suspicious scripting.
* Ability to follow structured procedures, playbooks, and escalation paths with precision and consistency.
* ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tool experience: ticket creation, classification, and documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and clear written communication for ticket notes, case documentation, and shift handoffs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior exposure to a SIEM platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar) for alert review or basic log analysis.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR tooling.
* Exposure to phishing analysis and email security tools (Mimecast, Abnormal.ai, or similar).
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework at a foundational level.
* Experience working in a 24×7 shift environment.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* CompTIA Security+ — preferred or actively pursuing.
* Microsoft SC-900 (Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) — a plus.
* CompTIA CySA+ or equivalent — desirable as a development target.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* SLA compliance and accurate, complete documentation for all assigned ServiceNow tickets.
* Alert triage accuracy: low false-positive closure rate and appropriate, timely escalations to L2.
* Shift handoff quality: all open items documented and communicated clearly with no gaps.
* Demonstrated progression in GreyMatter proficiency and foundational tool knowledge over the first 90 days.
* Positive contribution to team knowledge through flagging repeat patterns and supporting runbook updates.

The Senior Voice Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the reliable day-to-day operation, support and administration of enterprise voice, unified communications, contact centre and call-recording services. Based at MGN Bengaluru, the role provides timely support to onsite and remote-working users and contact centre agents, maintains platform availability and capacity, ensures complete call-recording compliance, and works closely with the Group Voice Team to resolve incidents and deliver controlled changes.

Operational Support: Provide L2/L3 support for voice-related issues affecting office users, remote-working users and contact centre agents. Perform advanced remote and onsite troubleshooting across IP telephony, softphones, endpoints, gateways, trunks, voicemail, conferencing and recording services. Own assigned tickets through diagnosis, restoration, user validation and closure within agreed service levels.
  
Monitoring, Health and Capacity: Complete documented daily, weekly and monthly health checks for voice, contact centre and recording platforms. Monitor service availability, alarms, trunk/channel usage, licences, storage, system capacity, endpoint status and resilience. Publish accurate health and capacity reports, highlight risks and exceptions, and recommend corrective or preventive actions.

Conduct scheduled recording validation, identify recording gaps promptly, coordinate remediation and maintain clear evidence for audit and compliance reviews. Escalate any recording failure or coverage risk immediately.
  
Incident and Problem Management: Participate actively in major incident, incident and problem-management processes. Troubleshoot service degradation and outages, provide timely technical updates, restore service with urgency, perform root-cause analysis and track permanent corrective actions to closure.

Prepare implementation, risk, rollback and validation plans; support maintenance activities; and ensure post-change monitoring and documentation.

Administration and Documentation: Administer user extensions, contact centre profiles, features, routing, licences and approved configuration changes. Maintain current architecture diagrams, configuration records, support procedures, inventory, vendor details, knowledge articles and shift handover records.
